entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, VeloFit agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I bought a jersey a while back, and I just... I need to return it. I feel terrible about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue?

It's a preference, I guess. I ordered the Pro-Line jersey, and it's just the wrong size. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the first time something hasn't been perfect. It's just too tight, and I feel so disappointed every time I look at it.

I'm very sorry to hear that it wasn't the right fit for you. I understand how disappointing that can be. Would you be interested in an exchange for a different size? We could get a new one shipped out to you right away.
An exchange would be nice, but... honestly, with the holidays, I was really hoping to get the money back. I just really needed this to work out, you know?
I completely understand. Not a problem at all. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get the order number, please?
Thank you. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the jersey was delivered 58 days ago. I'm happy to tell you that you are well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried it had been too long.

Not at all. We take care of our customers, and I can see you're one of our VIP members. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you, Alex. That's so much easier than I thought it would be.

It's my pleasure. And for the trouble with the sizing, I've also added a free express shipping credit to your account for your next order. We want to make sure you get the gear you love without any hassle. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's amazing. You've really turned my day around. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
